headings.description: Editorial, elegant serif for all major headings. Never center by default. Use fluid scaling. Add 'tracking-tight' to large headings.

body.description: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for body text and UI elements.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.overline: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-foreground font-sans

colors.description: Warm bone-white background (bright luxury) with deep charcoal/ink black for high contrast. Editorial aesthetic, avoiding stark pure white or pure black.

surfaces.cards: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border-border, no heavy shadows. Use soft diffuse ambient shadows only on hover (e.g. shadow-lg shadow-black/5).
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header and floating chat widget. backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border border-border/50.
surfaces.inputs: Editorial feel: thin 1px all-around borders or bottom-border only. No thick focus rings; use border-foreground on focus.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. gap-12 to gap-16 in grids.
visual_enhancers.borders: Radius small (rounded-sm or rounded-md) to keep it elegant and architectural.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 on load. Staggered fade up for hero image.
motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons: button translates up slightly (-translate-y-1) with soft shadow. Image hover: subtle scale in (scale-105) with overflow-hidden.

layouts.hero: Kinetic hero banner. Large central image (max-h-[80vh] w-full object-cover rounded-md), overlapping Floating Enquiry Box (bottom center, glassmorphism card bridging the image and next section).
layouts.portfolio: 2-column or 3-column asymmetric grid. Images use an Interactive Before/After slider implementation (users can drag to see edited vs unedited).
layouts.roadmap: Asymmetrical grid. 4 steps (Onboarding, Submission, Processing, Delivery & Revisions). Use massive outline numbers (text-8xl text-transparent border-stroke or text-muted/30) behind or beside the step content.
layouts.pricing: Comparison table. Use a CSS Grid layout with 1px borders between rows/cols to look like a crisp, technical document. Highlight the 'Standard' tier with a subtle background tint.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon (using react-fast-marquee). Very slow drift. Playfair Display, text-4xl or text-5xl, tracking-widest, displaying 'ELEVATE YOUR ART — RECLAIM YOUR TIME'.

components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50). Logo left, links center, CTA right.
components.floating_chat: Fixed bottom-right corner (z-50). Simple form-style widget inside a popover/card with a chat icon toggle.
components.enquiry_box: Floating over the hero banner bottom edge. Fields: 'Overwhelmed with editing? Drop your question here!' + simple input + submit button.
components.contact_form: Shadcn form. Fields: Name, Email, Purpose (Dropdown: General Inquiry, Custom Quote, Trial Edit), Message.
components.faq: Shadcn Accordion. Minimalist styling, thin borders. Questions: 'How do I share my Lightroom catalog?', 'What is your typical turnaround time?'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Playfair Display (font-serif) for all headings and Manrope (font-sans) for body text from Google Fonts.

For the Before/After slider in Portfolio, you can create a custom React component using an input type='range' to control the width/clip-path of the 'After' image overlaid on the 'Before' image. Apply grayscale to the 'Before' image state if you don't have separate edited/unedited URLs, to simulate the effect.
Hero Section: The H1 should use framer-motion to reveal line by line (overflow-hidden wrapper with text translating up).
Floating Enquiry Box: Position it absolutely overlapping the bottom edge of the hero image. Use z-10 and backdrop-blur.

Pricing table: Implement a 5-tier comparison table (Basic $100, Basic Plus $140, Standard $250, Premium $450, Custom). Columns: Plan, Max Submitted Images, Final Delivered Count, Revisions, Price, Service Provided.
Contact Form: Use Shadcn form. Include Name, Email, and a Select dropdown for Purpose.
Live Chatbox: Fixed positioned at bottom right. Clicking it opens a small card with a form that saves messages.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Implement the smooth scrolling using framer-motion or a custom useScroll hook if lenis isn't available, but prioritize the editorial scroll feel.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for elegant, duotone, or thin icons that match the editorial aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the main App container. Left-align content where appropriate.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (simplistic gradients, uniform styling, tight spacing). Use solid warm colors and high contrast.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Use p-8, p-16, gap-12 generously.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, dropdowns, but heavily customize them to match the editorial, flat, thin-border aesthetic. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns.
NEVER use placeholder images from placehold.it or similar. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Apply css_vars provided in the colors section to index.css :root and .dark classes.
